# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1454
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1454
- **Title**: gh-1446 [GOAL] TUI chrome diet: textless fold rule, running/lost-only jobs line, live activity animation in the reserved _ Fa brand slot
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1446` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 55
- **Additions**: +1129
- **Deletions**: -566
- **Created**: 2026-10-09T14:51:10Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-09T20:45:25Z

## PR Description

Closes #1446
### What changed

TUI transient chrome becomes signal-only (gh-1446): the streaming fold row renders as a textless dim rule (`─`×width, count retracted), the background-jobs line collapses to `<status.running glyph> Background jobs (R)` + `· L lost` (done count and `older` noise dropped; `older` kept only as the frozen pre-turn provenance marker), the busy row loses its kaomoji face (plain label at column 0), and the `>_ Fa` brand mark gains a fixed 1-cell animation slot cycling the existing braille activity ring while a run streams.

### Key decisions

- All status glyphs route through the central symbol table (`TuiSymbols`): `status.running` = `◐`, `status.pending` = `○` (unicode defaults); waiting rows, hub/tree/chrome/tool-liveness hardcoded `⏳`/`⟳` all migrated — the ascii preset can never emit a non-ASCII glyph (AC8 grep is clean outside `tui_symbols.dart`).
- Brand animation stays pure: the host resolves `StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame` from the compile-time `activitySpinner` off the live tick frame (`FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph`); the engine never reads frames, and model text can never become a frame. Idle renders the blank cell so the ` Fa` column is constant.
- Jobs line clip priority is `lost > parens > icon` with a tail-keep fallback — at width 40 with `999 lost` the digits survive; live line never contains `running`/`done` substrings; the settled transcript summary card keeps its terminal counts (deliberate non-goal).
- #827's reserved row budget, #365 fixed-cell busy layout, and #539 frozen older-row snapshots all preserved; the busy tick chain remains the single animation clock (ctrl+C hint hides the row with the animation — no orphan ticker).

### How to verify

```bash
flutter test test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart test/cli/tui_symbols_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_busy_row_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_kaomoji_test.dart \
  test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_band_composer_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_viewport_fold_test.dart test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart
flutter test test/cli  # 3416 passed (1 pre-existing env failure, see below)
```

Note: `backend_mode_cli_test`, `headless_log_file_test`, `agent_cli_task_completion_wake_test`, `browser_ext/*` (Chrome/D-Bus unavailable) fail identically on the base commit `e3d0dc5` — pre-existing runner-environment issues, untouched here.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  TICK[SpinnerTickMsg 100ms] --> MODEL[FaTuiModel.spinnerFrame]
  MODEL --> CTL[FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph]
  CTL --> SNAP[StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame]
  SNAP --> PI[_renderPi: >_ + frame + Fa]
  SNAP --> BAND[band writer: fade roles kept]
  BOARD[ShellJobBoard.liveLines] --> LINE[shellJobLiveSummaryLine: glyph + (R) + L lost]
  LINE --> CLIP[_tailKeep clip ladder: lost > parens > icon]
  ROWS[_busyRowLine] --> PLAIN[plain label col 0 - no face]
  SYM[TuiSymbols presets] --> LINE & ROWS & WAIT[waiting rows: status.pending]
```

</details>

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: the cache-write glyph silently changes on every preset — outside the ticket's four touchpoints and untested**

This swaps the hardcoded `⟳` for `sym('icon.cache')`, which is **not** a 1-cell restyle of the same glyph — it changes what users see on every preset:

- unicode: `⟳1.2k` → `💾1.2k`
- nerd: `⟳1.2k` → U+F1C0 database glyph
- ascii: `⟳1.2k` → **`cache1.2k`** — +4 cells on a width-budgeted status line, which can crowd/clip sibling segments at narrow widths

Two problems:

1. **Scope**: the ticket names exactly four touchpoints (fold row, jobs line, busy row, brand mark) plus the AC8 waiting/hub/tree/chrome/liveness glyph migration. The cache-write segment is in none of them, the capability table doesn't cover it, and no test pins the new rendering (the `pi` pin was updated; `cache_write` has none). AC8 only required eliminating the hardcoded `⟳` — routing it through `status.running` would have preserved the visual.
2. **Consistency**: the sibling cache-**read** segment right above still hardcodes `⟲`, so the matched `⟲`/`⟳` pair becomes `⟲`/`💾`.

Fix: route cache-read/cache-write through matching symbol keys (or keep both on the old glyph via a dedicated 1-cell key), and add a `cache_write` text pin next to the updated `pi` pin. As a minimum, call the change out in the PR description.

💡 **SUGGESTION: the grep anchor hardcodes the glyph this PR just retired**

`livenessLines` keys on the literal `'○ ['` — the same hardcoded-status-glyph pattern AC8 removes from chrome code, now moved into a test helper. Every other updated helper derives the glyph (`'${FaThemeController.instance.sym('status.pending')} waiting'` in the PTY waiting-row suite). Derive here too:

```dart
final pending = FaThemeController.instance.sym('status.pending');
List<String> livenessLines(String out) =>
    out.split('\n').where((line) => line.contains('$pending [')).toList();
```

The direct `'○ [bash] …'` string expectations in this file are fine (they pin the unicode default); only the reusable grep anchor drifts if the preset ever changes.

---

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-09):

💡 **SUGGESTION: the new busy-row opener heuristic is broad — any capitalized "…" line now suppresses the gutter rule**

`[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9 /,&+()-]+…` matches any capitalized words ending in an ellipsis, so transcript/model-echo content like `Here is the plan…` or `Summary of changes…` (with the elapsed cell absent) satisfies the opener. The `not`-rules at lines 135/148 use this alone to suppress the `╰─` gutter and separator rules, so a quoted ellipsis line near the bottom can hide live chrome for a frame. The herdr-contract test only pins the negative case for the *closer* (`'the log said Working… and moved on'` fails only because the elapsed cell is missing there too).

This is a deliberate trade-off (the harness-authored `busyPhase` labels are free-form text, and the old face-prefix key is gone) — but consider documenting the false-positive class in the manifest comment, or narrowing the generic branch to the four fixed labels plus an explicit `busyPhase` vocabulary if one exists.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1454
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1454
- **Title**: gh-1446 [GOAL] TUI chrome diet: textless fold rule, running/lost-only jobs line, live activity animation in the reserved _ Fa brand slot
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1446` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 55
- **Additions**: +1129
- **Deletions**: -566
- **Created**: 2026-10-09T14:51:10Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-09T20:45:25Z

## PR Description

Closes #1446
### What changed

TUI transient chrome becomes signal-only (gh-1446): the streaming fold row renders as a textless dim rule (`─`×width, count retracted), the background-jobs line collapses to `<status.running glyph> Background jobs (R)` + `· L lost` (done count and `older` noise dropped; `older` kept only as the frozen pre-turn provenance marker), the busy row loses its kaomoji face (plain label at column 0), and the `>_ Fa` brand mark gains a fixed 1-cell animation slot cycling the existing braille activity ring while a run streams.

### Key decisions

- All status glyphs route through the central symbol table (`TuiSymbols`): `status.running` = `◐`, `status.pending` = `○` (unicode defaults); waiting rows, hub/tree/chrome/tool-liveness hardcoded `⏳`/`⟳` all migrated — the ascii preset can never emit a non-ASCII glyph (AC8 grep is clean outside `tui_symbols.dart`).
- Brand animation stays pure: the host resolves `StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame` from the compile-time `activitySpinner` off the live tick frame (`FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph`); the engine never reads frames, and model text can never become a frame. Idle renders the blank cell so the ` Fa` column is constant.
- Jobs line clip priority is `lost > parens > icon` with a tail-keep fallback — at width 40 with `999 lost` the digits survive; live line never contains `running`/`done` substrings; the settled transcript summary card keeps its terminal counts (deliberate non-goal).
- #827's reserved row budget, #365 fixed-cell busy layout, and #539 frozen older-row snapshots all preserved; the busy tick chain remains the single animation clock (ctrl+C hint hides the row with the animation — no orphan ticker).

### How to verify

```bash
flutter test test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart test/cli/tui_symbols_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_busy_row_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_kaomoji_test.dart \
  test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_band_composer_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_viewport_fold_test.dart test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart
flutter test test/cli  # 3416 passed (1 pre-existing env failure, see below)
```

Note: `backend_mode_cli_test`, `headless_log_file_test`, `agent_cli_task_completion_wake_test`, `browser_ext/*` (Chrome/D-Bus unavailable) fail identically on the base commit `e3d0dc5` — pre-existing runner-environment issues, untouched here.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  TICK[SpinnerTickMsg 100ms] --> MODEL[FaTuiModel.spinnerFrame]
  MODEL --> CTL[FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph]
  CTL --> SNAP[StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame]
  SNAP --> PI[_renderPi: >_ + frame + Fa]
  SNAP --> BAND[band writer: fade roles kept]
  BOARD[ShellJobBoard.liveLines] --> LINE[shellJobLiveSummaryLine: glyph + (R) + L lost]
  LINE --> CLIP[_tailKeep clip ladder: lost > parens > icon]
  ROWS[_busyRowLine] --> PLAIN[plain label col 0 - no face]
  SYM[TuiSymbols presets] --> LINE & ROWS & WAIT[waiting rows: status.pending]
```

</details>

- **Author**: ai-teammate

## PR Description

Closes #1446
### What changed

TUI transient chrome becomes signal-only (gh-1446): the streaming fold row renders as a textless dim rule (`─`×width, count retracted), the background-jobs line collapses to `<status.running glyph> Background jobs (R)` + `· L lost` (done count and `older` noise dropped; `older` kept only as the frozen pre-turn provenance marker), the busy row loses its kaomoji face (plain label at column 0), and the `>_ Fa` brand mark gains a fixed 1-cell animation slot cycling the existing braille activity ring while a run streams.

### Key decisions

- All status glyphs route through the central symbol table (`TuiSymbols`): `status.running` = `◐`, `status.pending` = `○` (unicode defaults); waiting rows, hub/tree/chrome/tool-liveness hardcoded `⏳`/`⟳` all migrated — the ascii preset can never emit a non-ASCII glyph (AC8 grep is clean outside `tui_symbols.dart`).
- Brand animation stays pure: the host resolves `StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame` from the compile-time `activitySpinner` off the live tick frame (`FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph`); the engine never reads frames, and model text can never become a frame. Idle renders the blank cell so the ` Fa` column is constant.
- Jobs line clip priority is `lost > parens > icon` with a tail-keep fallback — at width 40 with `999 lost` the digits survive; live line never contains `running`/`done` substrings; the settled transcript summary card keeps its terminal counts (deliberate non-goal).
- #827's reserved row budget, #365 fixed-cell busy layout, and #539 frozen older-row snapshots all preserved; the busy tick chain remains the single animation clock (ctrl+C hint hides the row with the animation — no orphan ticker).

### How to verify

```bash
flutter test test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart test/cli/tui_symbols_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_busy_row_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_kaomoji_test.dart \
  test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_band_composer_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_viewport_fold_test.dart test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart
flutter test test/cli  # 3416 passed (1 pre-existing env failure, see below)
```

Note: `backend_mode_cli_test`, `headless_log_file_test`, `agent_cli_task_completion_wake_test`, `browser_ext/*` (Chrome/D-Bus unavailable) fail identically on the base commit `e3d0dc5` — pre-existing runner-environment issues, untouched here.

flowchart TD
  TICK[SpinnerTickMsg 100ms] --> MODEL[FaTuiModel.spinnerFrame]
  MODEL --> CTL[FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph]

- **Author**: ai-teammate

- **Updated**: 2026-10-09T20:45:25Z

## PR Description

Closes #1446
### What changed

TUI transient chrome becomes signal-only (gh-1446): the streaming fold row renders as a textless dim rule (`─`×width, count retracted), the background-jobs line collapses to `<status.running glyph> Background jobs (R)` + `· L lost` (done count and `older` noise dropped; `older` kept only as the frozen pre-turn provenance marker), the busy row loses its kaomoji face (plain label at column 0), and the `>_ Fa` brand mark gains a fixed 1-cell animation slot cycling the existing braille activity ring while a run streams.

### Key decisions

- All status glyphs route through the central symbol table (`TuiSymbols`): `status.running` = `◐`, `status.pending` = `○` (unicode defaults); waiting rows, hub/tree/chrome/tool-liveness hardcoded `⏳`/`⟳` all migrated — the ascii preset can never emit a non-ASCII glyph (AC8 grep is clean outside `tui_symbols.dart`).
- Brand animation stays pure: the host resolves `StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame` from the compile-time `activitySpinner` off the live tick frame (`FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph`); the engine never reads frames, and model text can never become a frame. Idle renders the blank cell so the ` Fa` column is constant.
- Jobs line clip priority is `lost > parens > icon` with a tail-keep fallback — at width 40 with `999 lost` the digits survive; live line never contains `running`/`done` substrings; the settled transcript summary card keeps its terminal counts (deliberate non-goal).
- #827's reserved row budget, #365 fixed-cell busy layout, and #539 frozen older-row snapshots all preserved; the busy tick chain remains the single animation clock (ctrl+C hint hides the row with the animation — no orphan ticker).

### How to verify

```bash
flutter test test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart test/cli/tui_symbols_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_busy_row_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_kaomoji_test.dart \
  test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_band_composer_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_viewport_fold_test.dart test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart
flutter test test/cli  # 3416 passed (1 pre-existing env failure, see below)
```

Note: `backend_mode_cli_test`, `headless_log_file_test`, `agent_cli_task_completion_wake_test`, `browser_ext/*` (Chrome/D-Bus unavailable) fail identically on the base commit `e3d0dc5` — pre-existing runner-environment issues, untouched here.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  TICK[SpinnerTickMsg 100ms] --> MODEL[FaTuiModel.spinnerFrame]
  MODEL --> CTL[FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph]

  SNAP --> BAND[band writer: fade roles kept]

- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1446` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 55
- **Additions**: +1129
- **Deletions**: -566
- **Created**: 2026-10-09T14:51:10Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-09T20:45:25Z

## PR Description

Closes #1446
### What changed

TUI transient chrome becomes signal-only (gh-1446): the streaming fold row renders as a textless dim rule (`─`×width, count retracted), the background-jobs line collapses to `<status.running glyph> Background jobs (R)` + `· L lost` (done count and `older` noise dropped; `older` kept only as the frozen pre-turn provenance marker), the busy row loses its kaomoji face (plain label at column 0), and the `>_ Fa` brand mark gains a fixed 1-cell animation slot cycling the existing braille activity ring while a run streams.

### Key decisions

- All status glyphs route through the central symbol table (`TuiSymbols`): `status.running` = `◐`, `status.pending` = `○` (unicode defaults); waiting rows, hub/tree/chrome/tool-liveness hardcoded `⏳`/`⟳` all migrated — the ascii preset can never emit a non-ASCII glyph (AC8 grep is clean outside `tui_symbols.dart`).
- Brand animation stays pure: the host resolves `StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame` from the compile-time `activitySpinner` off the live tick frame (`FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph`); the engine never reads frames, and model text can never become a frame. Idle renders the blank cell so the ` Fa` column is constant.
- Jobs line clip priority is `lost > parens > icon` with a tail-keep fallback — at width 40 with `999 lost` the digits survive; live line never contains `running`/`done` substrings; the settled transcript summary card keeps its terminal counts (deliberate non-goal).
- #827's reserved row budget, #365 fixed-cell busy layout, and #539 frozen older-row snapshots all preserved; the busy tick chain remains the single animation clock (ctrl+C hint hides the row with the animation — no orphan ticker).

### How to verify

```bash
flutter test test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart test/cli/tui_symbols_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_busy_row_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_kaomoji_test.dart \
  test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_band_composer_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_viewport_fold_test.dart test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart
flutter test test/cli  # 3416 passed (1 pre-existing env failure, see below)
```

Note: `backend_mode_cli_test`, `headless_log_file_test`, `agent_cli_task_completion_wake_test`, `browser_ext/*` (Chrome/D-Bus unavailable) fail identically on the base commit `e3d0dc5` — pre-existing runner-environment issues, untouched here.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  TICK[SpinnerTickMsg 100ms] --> MODEL[FaTuiModel.spinnerFrame]
  MODEL --> CTL[FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph]
  CTL --> SNAP[StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame]
  SNAP --> PI[_renderPi: >_ + frame + Fa]
  SNAP --> BAND[band writer: fade roles kept]
  BOARD[ShellJobBoard.liveLines] --> LINE[shellJobLiveSummaryLine: glyph + (R) + L lost]

  ROWS[_busyRowLine] --> PLAIN[plain label col 0 - no face]

```

- **Title**: gh-1446 [GOAL] TUI chrome diet: textless fold rule, running/lost-only jobs line, live activity animation in the reserved _ Fa brand slot
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1446` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 55
- **Additions**: +1129
- **Deletions**: -566
- **Created**: 2026-10-09T14:51:10Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-09T20:45:25Z

## PR Description

Closes #1446
### What changed

TUI transient chrome becomes signal-only (gh-1446): the streaming fold row renders as a textless dim rule (`─`×width, count retracted), the background-jobs line collapses to `<status.running glyph> Background jobs (R)` + `· L lost` (done count and `older` noise dropped; `older` kept only as the frozen pre-turn provenance marker), the busy row loses its kaomoji face (plain label at column 0), and the `>_ Fa` brand mark gains a fixed 1-cell animation slot cycling the existing braille activity ring while a run streams.

### Key decisions

- All status glyphs route through the central symbol table (`TuiSymbols`): `status.running` = `◐`, `status.pending` = `○` (unicode defaults); waiting rows, hub/tree/chrome/tool-liveness hardcoded `⏳`/`⟳` all migrated — the ascii preset can never emit a non-ASCII glyph (AC8 grep is clean outside `tui_symbols.dart`).
- Brand animation stays pure: the host resolves `StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame` from the compile-time `activitySpinner` off the live tick frame (`FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph`); the engine never reads frames, and model text can never become a frame. Idle renders the blank cell so the ` Fa` column is constant.
- Jobs line clip priority is `lost > parens > icon` with a tail-keep fallback — at width 40 with `999 lost` the digits survive; live line never contains `running`/`done` substrings; the settled transcript summary card keeps its terminal counts (deliberate non-goal).
- #827's reserved row budget, #365 fixed-cell busy layout, and #539 frozen older-row snapshots all preserved; the busy tick chain remains the single animation clock (ctrl+C hint hides the row with the animation — no orphan ticker).

### How to verify

```bash
flutter test test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart test/cli/tui_symbols_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_busy_row_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_kaomoji_test.dart \
  test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_band_composer_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_viewport_fold_test.dart test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart
flutter test test/cli  # 3416 passed (1 pre-existing env failure, see below)
```

Note: `backend_mode_cli_test`, `headless_log_file_test`, `agent_cli_task_completion_wake_test`, `browser_ext/*` (Chrome/D-Bus unavailable) fail identically on the base commit `e3d0dc5` — pre-existing runner-environment issues, untouched here.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  TICK[SpinnerTickMsg 100ms] --> MODEL[FaTuiModel.spinnerFrame]
  MODEL --> CTL[FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph]
  CTL --> SNAP[StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame]
  SNAP --> PI[_renderPi: >_ + frame + Fa]
  SNAP --> BAND[band writer: fade roles kept]
  BOARD[ShellJobBoard.liveLines] --> LINE[shellJobLiveSummaryLine: glyph + (R) + L lost]
  LINE --> CLIP[_tailKeep clip ladder: lost > parens > icon]
  ROWS[_busyRowLine] --> PLAIN[plain label col 0 - no face]
  SYM[TuiSymbols presets] --> LINE & ROWS & WAIT[waiting rows: status.pending]
```

</details>

## PR Description

Closes #1446
### What changed

TUI transient chrome becomes signal-only (gh-1446): the streaming fold row renders as a textless dim rule (`─`×width, count retracted), the background-jobs line collapses to `<status.running glyph> Background jobs (R)` + `· L lost` (done count and `older` noise dropped; `older` kept only as the frozen pre-turn provenance marker), the busy row loses its kaomoji face (plain label at column 0), and the `>_ Fa` brand mark gains a fixed 1-cell animation slot cycling the existing braille activity ring while a run streams.

### Key decisions

- All status glyphs route through the central symbol table (`TuiSymbols`): `status.running` = `◐`, `status.pending` = `○` (unicode defaults); waiting rows, hub/tree/chrome/tool-liveness hardcoded `⏳`/`⟳` all migrated — the ascii preset can never emit a non-ASCII glyph (AC8 grep is clean outside `tui_symbols.dart`).
- Brand animation stays pure: the host resolves `StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame` from the compile-time `activitySpinner` off the live tick frame (`FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph`); the engine never reads frames, and model text can never become a frame. Idle renders the blank cell so the ` Fa` column is constant.
- Jobs line clip priority is `lost > parens > icon` with a tail-keep fallback — at width 40 with `999 lost` the digits survive; live line never contains `running`/`done` substrings; the settled transcript summary card keeps its terminal counts (deliberate non-goal).
- #827's reserved row budget, #365 fixed-cell busy layout, and #539 frozen older-row snapshots all preserved; the busy tick chain remains the single animation clock (ctrl+C hint hides the row with the animation — no orphan ticker).

### How to verify

```bash

## PR Description

Closes #1446
### What changed

TUI transient chrome becomes signal-only (gh-1446): the streaming fold row renders as a textless dim rule (`─`×width, count retracted), the background-jobs line collapses to `<status.running glyph> Background jobs (R)` + `· L lost` (done count and `older` noise dropped; `older` kept only as the frozen pre-turn provenance marker), the busy row loses its kaomoji face (plain label at column 0), and the `>_ Fa` brand mark gains a fixed 1-cell animation slot cycling the existing braille activity ring while a run streams.

### Key decisions

- All status glyphs route through the central symbol table (`TuiSymbols`): `status.running` = `◐`, `status.pending` = `○` (unicode defaults); waiting rows, hub/tree/chrome/tool-liveness hardcoded `⏳`/`⟳` all migrated — the ascii preset can never emit a non-ASCII glyph (AC8 grep is clean outside `tui_symbols.dart`).
- Brand animation stays pure: the host resolves `StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame` from the compile-time `activitySpinner` off the live tick frame (`FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph`); the engine never reads frames, and model text can never become a frame. Idle renders the blank cell so the ` Fa` column is constant.
- Jobs line clip priority is `lost > parens > icon` with a tail-keep fallback — at width 40 with `999 lost` the digits survive; live line never contains `running`/`done` substrings; the settled transcript summary card keeps its terminal counts (deliberate non-goal).
- #827's reserved row budget, #365 fixed-cell busy layout, and #539 frozen older-row snapshots all preserved; the busy tick chain remains the single animation clock (ctrl+C hint hides the row with the animation — no orphan ticker).

### How to verify

```bash
flutter test test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart test/cli/tui_symbols_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_busy_row_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_kaomoji_test.dart \
  test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_band_composer_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_viewport_fold_test.dart test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart
flutter test test/cli  # 3416 passed (1 pre-existing env failure, see below)
```

Note: `backend_mode_cli_test`, `headless_log_file_test`, `agent_cli_task_completion_wake_test`, `browser_ext/*` (Chrome/D-Bus unavailable) fail identically on the base commit `e3d0dc5` — pre-existing runner-environment issues, untouched here.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  TICK[SpinnerTickMsg 100ms] --> MODEL[FaTuiModel.spinnerFrame]
  MODEL --> CTL[FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph]
  CTL --> SNAP[StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame]
  SNAP --> PI[_renderPi: >_ + frame + Fa]
  SNAP --> BAND[band writer: fade roles kept]
  BOARD[ShellJobBoard.liveLines] --> LINE[shellJobLiveSummaryLine: glyph + (R) + L lost]

  ROWS[_busyRowLine] --> PLAIN[plain label col 0 - no face]

```

- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1446` → `main`
- **State**: open

- **Deletions**: -566

- **Updated**: 2026-10-09T20:45:25Z

## PR Description

Closes #1446
### What changed

TUI transient chrome becomes signal-only (gh-1446): the streaming fold row renders as a textless dim rule (`─`×width, count retracted), the background-jobs line collapses to `<status.running glyph> Background jobs (R)` + `· L lost` (done count and `older` noise dropped; `older` kept only as the frozen pre-turn provenance marker), the busy row loses its kaomoji face (plain label at column 0), and the `>_ Fa` brand mark gains a fixed 1-cell animation slot cycling the existing braille activity ring while a run streams.

### Key decisions

- All status glyphs route through the central symbol table (`TuiSymbols`): `status.running` = `◐`, `status.pending` = `○` (unicode defaults); waiting rows, hub/tree/chrome/tool-liveness hardcoded `⏳`/`⟳` all migrated — the ascii preset can never emit a non-ASCII glyph (AC8 grep is clean outside `tui_symbols.dart`).
- Brand animation stays pure: the host resolves `StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame` from the compile-time `activitySpinner` off the live tick frame (`FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph`); the engine never reads frames, and model text can never become a frame. Idle renders the blank cell so the ` Fa` column is constant.
- Jobs line clip priority is `lost > parens > icon` with a tail-keep fallback — at width 40 with `999 lost` the digits survive; live line never contains `running`/`done` substrings; the settled transcript summary card keeps its terminal counts (deliberate non-goal).
- #827's reserved row budget, #365 fixed-cell busy layout, and #539 frozen older-row snapshots all preserved; the busy tick chain remains the single animation clock (ctrl+C hint hides the row with the animation — no orphan ticker).

### How to verify

```bash
flutter test test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart test/cli/tui_symbols_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_busy_row_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_kaomoji_test.dart \
  test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_band_composer_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_viewport_fold_test.dart test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart
flutter test test/cli  # 3416 passed (1 pre-existing env failure, see below)
```

Note: `backend_mode_cli_test`, `headless_log_file_test`, `agent_cli_task_completion_wake_test`, `browser_ext/*` (Chrome/D-Bus unavailable) fail identically on the base commit `e3d0dc5` — pre-existing runner-environment issues, untouched here.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  TICK[SpinnerTickMsg 100ms] --> MODEL[FaTuiModel.spinnerFrame]
  MODEL --> CTL[FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph]
  CTL --> SNAP[StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame]

  SNAP --> BAND[band writer: fade roles kept]

```

## PR Description

Closes #1446
### What changed

TUI transient chrome becomes signal-only (gh-1446): the streaming fold row renders as a textless dim rule (`─`×width, count retracted), the background-jobs line collapses to `<status.running glyph> Background jobs (R)` + `· L lost` (done count and `older` noise dropped; `older` kept only as the frozen pre-turn provenance marker), the busy row loses its kaomoji face (plain label at column 0), and the `>_ Fa` brand mark gains a fixed 1-cell animation slot cycling the existing braille activity ring while a run streams.

### Key decisions

- All status glyphs route through the central symbol table (`TuiSymbols`): `status.running` = `◐`, `status.pending` = `○` (unicode defaults); waiting rows, hub/tree/chrome/tool-liveness hardcoded `⏳`/`⟳` all migrated — the ascii preset can never emit a non-ASCII glyph (AC8 grep is clean outside `tui_symbols.dart`).
- Brand animation stays pure: the host resolves `StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame` from the compile-time `activitySpinner` off the live tick frame (`FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph`); the engine never reads frames, and model text can never become a frame. Idle renders the blank cell so the ` Fa` column is constant.
- Jobs line clip priority is `lost > parens > icon` with a tail-keep fallback — at width 40 with `999 lost` the digits survive; live line never contains `running`/`done` substrings; the settled transcript summary card keeps its terminal counts (deliberate non-goal).
- #827's reserved row budget, #365 fixed-cell busy layout, and #539 frozen older-row snapshots all preserved; the busy tick chain remains the single animation clock (ctrl+C hint hides the row with the animation — no orphan ticker).

### How to verify

```bash
flutter test test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart test/cli/tui_symbols_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_busy_row_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_kaomoji_test.dart \

  test/cli/fa_tui_viewport_fold_test.dart test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart
flutter test test/cli  # 3416 passed (1 pre-existing env failure, see below)
```

Note: `backend_mode_cli_test`, `headless_log_file_test`, `agent_cli_task_completion_wake_test`, `browser_ext/*` (Chrome/D-Bus unavailable) fail identically on the base commit `e3d0dc5` — pre-existing runner-environment issues, untouched here.

- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1446` → `main`
- **State**: open

- **Updated**: 2026-10-09T20:45:25Z

## PR Description

Closes #1446
### What changed

TUI transient chrome becomes signal-only (gh-1446): the streaming fold row renders as a textless dim rule (`─`×width, count retracted), the background-jobs line collapses to `<status.running glyph> Background jobs (R)` + `· L lost` (done count and `older` noise dropped; `older` kept only as the frozen pre-turn provenance marker), the busy row loses its kaomoji face (plain label at column 0), and the `>_ Fa` brand mark gains a fixed 1-cell animation slot cycling the existing braille activity ring while a run streams.

### Key decisions

- All status glyphs route through the central symbol table (`TuiSymbols`): `status.running` = `◐`, `status.pending` = `○` (unicode defaults); waiting rows, hub/tree/chrome/tool-liveness hardcoded `⏳`/`⟳` all migrated — the ascii preset can never emit a non-ASCII glyph (AC8 grep is clean outside `tui_symbols.dart`).
- Brand animation stays pure: the host resolves `StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame` from the compile-time `activitySpinner` off the live tick frame (`FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph`); the engine never reads frames, and model text can never become a frame. Idle renders the blank cell so the ` Fa` column is constant.
- Jobs line clip priority is `lost > parens > icon` with a tail-keep fallback — at width 40 with `999 lost` the digits survive; live line never contains `running`/`done` substrings; the settled transcript summary card keeps its terminal counts (deliberate non-goal).
- #827's reserved row budget, #365 fixed-cell busy layout, and #539 frozen older-row snapshots all preserved; the busy tick chain remains the single animation clock (ctrl+C hint hides the row with the animation — no orphan ticker).

### How to verify

```bash
flutter test test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart test/cli/tui_symbols_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_busy_row_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_kaomoji_test.dart \
  test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_band_composer_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_viewport_fold_test.dart test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart
flutter test test/cli  # 3416 passed (1 pre-existing env failure, see below)
```

Note: `backend_mode_cli_test`, `headless_log_file_test`, `agent_cli_task_completion_wake_test`, `browser_ext/*` (Chrome/D-Bus unavailable) fail identically on the base commit `e3d0dc5` — pre-existing runner-environment issues, untouched here.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  TICK[SpinnerTickMsg 100ms] --> MODEL[FaTuiModel.spinnerFrame]
  MODEL --> CTL[FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph]
  CTL --> SNAP[StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame]
  SNAP --> PI[_renderPi: >_ + frame + Fa]
  SNAP --> BAND[band writer: fade roles kept]
  BOARD[ShellJobBoard.liveLines] --> LINE[shellJobLiveSummaryLine: glyph + (R) + L lost]

  ROWS[_busyRowLine] --> PLAIN[plain label col 0 - no face]

## PR Description

Closes #1446
### What changed

TUI transient chrome becomes signal-only (gh-1446): the streaming fold row renders as a textless dim rule (`─`×width, count retracted), the background-jobs line collapses to `<status.running glyph> Background jobs (R)` + `· L lost` (done count and `older` noise dropped; `older` kept only as the frozen pre-turn provenance marker), the busy row loses its kaomoji face (plain label at column 0), and the `>_ Fa` brand mark gains a fixed 1-cell animation slot cycling the existing braille activity ring while a run streams.

### Key decisions

- All status glyphs route through the central symbol table (`TuiSymbols`): `status.running` = `◐`, `status.pending` = `○` (unicode defaults); waiting rows, hub/tree/chrome/tool-liveness hardcoded `⏳`/`⟳` all migrated — the ascii preset can never emit a non-ASCII glyph (AC8 grep is clean outside `tui_symbols.dart`).
- Brand animation stays pure: the host resolves `StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame` from the compile-time `activitySpinner` off the live tick frame (`FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph`); the engine never reads frames, and model text can never become a frame. Idle renders the blank cell so the ` Fa` column is constant.
- Jobs line clip priority is `lost > parens > icon` with a tail-keep fallback — at width 40 with `999 lost` the digits survive; live line never contains `running`/`done` substrings; the settled transcript summary card keeps its terminal counts (deliberate non-goal).
- #827's reserved row budget, #365 fixed-cell busy layout, and #539 frozen older-row snapshots all preserved; the busy tick chain remains the single animation clock (ctrl+C hint hides the row with the animation — no orphan ticker).

### How to verify

```bash
flutter test test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart test/cli/tui_symbols_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_busy_row_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_kaomoji_test.dart \
  test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_band_composer_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_viewport_fold_test.dart test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart
flutter test test/cli  # 3416 passed (1 pre-existing env failure, see below)
```

Note: `backend_mode_cli_test`, `headless_log_file_test`, `agent_cli_task_completion_wake_test`, `browser_ext/*` (Chrome/D-Bus unavailable) fail identically on the base commit `e3d0dc5` — pre-existing runner-environment issues, untouched here.

  TICK[SpinnerTickMsg 100ms] --> MODEL[FaTuiModel.spinnerFrame]

## PR Description

Closes #1446
### What changed

TUI transient chrome becomes signal-only (gh-1446): the streaming fold row renders as a textless dim rule (`─`×width, count retracted), the background-jobs line collapses to `<status.running glyph> Background jobs (R)` + `· L lost` (done count and `older` noise dropped; `older` kept only as the frozen pre-turn provenance marker), the busy row loses its kaomoji face (plain label at column 0), and the `>_ Fa` brand mark gains a fixed 1-cell animation slot cycling the existing braille activity ring while a run streams.

### Key decisions

- All status glyphs route through the central symbol table (`TuiSymbols`): `status.running` = `◐`, `status.pending` = `○` (unicode defaults); waiting rows, hub/tree/chrome/tool-liveness hardcoded `⏳`/`⟳` all migrated — the ascii preset can never emit a non-ASCII glyph (AC8 grep is clean outside `tui_symbols.dart`).
- Brand animation stays pure: the host resolves `StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame` from the compile-time `activitySpinner` off the live tick frame (`FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph`); the engine never reads frames, and model text can never become a frame. Idle renders the blank cell so the ` Fa` column is constant.
- Jobs line clip priority is `lost > parens > icon` with a tail-keep fallback — at width 40 with `999 lost` the digits survive; live line never contains `running`/`done` substrings; the settled transcript summary card keeps its terminal counts (deliberate non-goal).
- #827's reserved row budget, #365 fixed-cell busy layout, and #539 frozen older-row snapshots all preserved; the busy tick chain remains the single animation clock (ctrl+C hint hides the row with the animation — no orphan ticker).

### How to verify

```bash
flutter test test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart test/cli/tui_symbols_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_busy_row_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_kaomoji_test.dart \
  test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_band_composer_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_viewport_fold_test.dart test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart
flutter test test/cli  # 3416 passed (1 pre-existing env failure, see below)
```

Note: `backend_mode_cli_test`, `headless_log_file_test`, `agent_cli_task_completion_wake_test`, `browser_ext/*` (Chrome/D-Bus unavailable) fail identically on the base commit `e3d0dc5` — pre-existing runner-environment issues, untouched here.

flowchart TD
  TICK[SpinnerTickMsg 100ms] --> MODEL[FaTuiModel.spinnerFrame]
  MODEL --> CTL[FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph]

## PR Description

Closes #1446
### What changed

TUI transient chrome becomes signal-only (gh-1446): the streaming fold row renders as a textless dim rule (`─`×width, count retracted), the background-jobs line collapses to `<status.running glyph> Background jobs (R)` + `· L lost` (done count and `older` noise dropped; `older` kept only as the frozen pre-turn provenance marker), the busy row loses its kaomoji face (plain label at column 0), and the `>_ Fa` brand mark gains a fixed 1-cell animation slot cycling the existing braille activity ring while a run streams.

### Key decisions

- All status glyphs route through the central symbol table (`TuiSymbols`): `status.running` = `◐`, `status.pending` = `○` (unicode defaults); waiting rows, hub/tree/chrome/tool-liveness hardcoded `⏳`/`⟳` all migrated — the ascii preset can never emit a non-ASCII glyph (AC8 grep is clean outside `tui_symbols.dart`).
- Brand animation stays pure: the host resolves `StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame` from the compile-time `activitySpinner` off the live tick frame (`FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph`); the engine never reads frames, and model text can never become a frame. Idle renders the blank cell so the ` Fa` column is constant.
- Jobs line clip priority is `lost > parens > icon` with a tail-keep fallback — at width 40 with `999 lost` the digits survive; live line never contains `running`/`done` substrings; the settled transcript summary card keeps its terminal counts (deliberate non-goal).
- #827's reserved row budget, #365 fixed-cell busy layout, and #539 frozen older-row snapshots all preserved; the busy tick chain remains the single animation clock (ctrl+C hint hides the row with the animation — no orphan ticker).

### How to verify

```bash
flutter test test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart test/cli/tui_symbols_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_busy_row_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_kaomoji_test.dart \
  test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_band_composer_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_viewport_fold_test.dart test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart
flutter test test/cli  # 3416 passed (1 pre-existing env failure, see below)
```

Note: `backend_mode_cli_test`, `headless_log_file_test`, `agent_cli_task_completion_wake_test`, `browser_ext/*` (Chrome/D-Bus unavailable) fail identically on the base commit `e3d0dc5` — pre-existing runner-environment issues, untouched here.

  TICK[SpinnerTickMsg 100ms] --> MODEL[FaTuiModel.spinnerFrame]

{"content":"⚠️ **IMPORTANT: the cache-write glyph silently changes on every preset — outside the ticket's four touchpoints and untested**

This swaps the hardcoded `⟳` for `sym('icon.cache')`, which is **not** a 1-cell restyle of the same glyph — it changes what users see on every preset:

- unicode: `⟳1.2k` → `💾1.2k`
- nerd: `⟳1.2k` → U+F1C0 database glyph
- ascii: `⟳1.2k` → **`cache1.2k`** — +4 cells on a width-budgeted status line, which can crowd/clip sibling segments at narrow widths

Two problems:

1. **Scope**: the ticket names exactly four touchpoints (fold row, jobs line, busy row, brand mark) plus the AC8 waiting/hub/tree/chrome/liveness glyph migration. The cache-write segment is in none of them, the capability table doesn't cover it, and no test pins the new rendering (the `pi` pin was updated; `cache_write` has none). AC8 only required eliminating the hardcoded `⟳` — routing it through `status.running` would have preserved the visual.

## PR Description

Closes #1446
### What changed

TUI transient chrome becomes signal-only (gh-1446): the streaming fold row renders as a textless dim rule (`─`×width, count retracted), the background-jobs line collapses to `<status.running glyph> Background jobs (R)` + `· L lost` (done count and `older` noise dropped; `older` kept only as the frozen pre-turn provenance marker), the busy row loses its kaomoji face (plain label at column 0), and the `>_ Fa` brand mark gains a fixed 1-cell animation slot cycling the existing braille activity ring while a run streams.

### Key decisions

- All status glyphs route through the central symbol table (`TuiSymbols`): `status.running` = `◐`, `status.pending` = `○` (unicode defaults); waiting rows, hub/tree/chrome/tool-liveness hardcoded `⏳`/`⟳` all migrated — the ascii preset can never emit a non-ASCII glyph (AC8 grep is clean outside `tui_symbols.dart`).
- Brand animation stays pure: the host resolves `StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame` from the compile-time `activitySpinner` off the live tick frame (`FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph`); the engine never reads frames, and model text can never become a frame. Idle renders the blank cell so the ` Fa` column is constant.
- Jobs line clip priority is `lost > parens > icon` with a tail-keep fallback — at width 40 with `999 lost` the digits survive; live line never contains `running`/`done` substrings; the settled transcript summary card keeps its terminal counts (deliberate non-goal).
- #827's reserved row budget, #365 fixed-cell busy layout, and #539 frozen older-row snapshots all preserved; the busy tick chain remains the single animation clock (ctrl+C hint hides the row with the animation — no orphan ticker).

### How to verify

```bash
flutter test test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart test/cli/tui_symbols_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_busy_row_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_kaomoji_test.dart \
  test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_band_composer_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_viewport_fold_test.dart test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart
flutter test test/cli  # 3416 passed (1 pre-existing env failure, see below)
```

Note: `backend_mode_cli_test`, `headless_log_file_test`, `agent_cli_task_completion_wake_test`, `browser_ext/*` (Chrome/D-Bus unavailable) fail identically on the base commit `e3d0dc5` — pre-existing runner-environment issues, untouched here.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  TICK[SpinnerTickMsg 100ms] --> MODEL[FaTuiModel.spinnerFrame]
  MODEL --> CTL[FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph]
  CTL --> SNAP[StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame]
  SNAP --> PI[_renderPi: >_ + frame + Fa]
  SNAP --> BAND[band writer: fade roles kept]
  BOARD[ShellJobBoard.liveLines] --> LINE[shellJobLiveSummaryLine: glyph + (R) + L lost]

  ROWS[_busyRowLine] --> PLAIN[plain label col 0 - no face]

```

{"content":"⚠️ **IMPORTANT: the cache-write glyph silently changes on every preset — outside the ticket's four touchpoints and untested**

This swaps the hardcoded `⟳` for `sym('icon.cache')`, which is **not** a 1-cell restyle of the same glyph — it changes what users see on every preset:

- unicode: `⟳1.2k` → `💾1.2k`
- nerd: `⟳1.2k` → U+F1C0 database glyph
- ascii: `⟳1.2k` → **`cache1.2k`** — +4 cells on a width-budgeted status line, which can crowd/clip sibling segments at narrow widths

Two problems:

1. **Scope**: the ticket names exactly four touchpoints (fold row, jobs line, busy row, brand mark) plus the AC8 waiting/hub/tree/chrome/liveness glyph migration. The cache-write segment is in none of them, the capability table doesn't cover it, and no test pins the new rendering (the `pi` pin was updated; `cache_write` has none). AC8 only required eliminating the hardcoded `⟳` — routing it through `status.running` would have preserved the visual.
2. **Consistency**: the sibling cache-**read** segment right above still hardcodes `⟲`, so the matched `⟲`/`⟳` pair becomes `⟲`/`💾`.

Fix: route cache-read/cache-write through matching symbol keys (or keep both on the old glyph via a dedicated 1-cell key), and add a `cache_write` text pin next to the updated `pi` pin. As a minimum, call the change out in the PR description.

{"content":"💡 **SUGGESTION: the new busy-row opener heuristic is broad — any capitalized "…" line now suppresses the gutter rule**

`[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9 /,&+()-]+…` matches any capitalized words ending in an ellipsis, so transcript/model-echo content like `Here is the plan…` or `Summary of changes…` (with the elapsed cell absent) satisfies the opener. The `not`-rules at lines 135/148 use this alone to suppress the `╰─` gutter and separator rules, so a quoted ellipsis line near the bottom can hide live chrome for a frame. The herdr-contract test only pins the negative case for the *closer* (`'the log said Working… and moved on'` fails only because the elapsed cell is missing there too).

This is a deliberate trade-off (the harness-authored `busyPhase` labels are free-form text, and the old face-prefix key is gone) — but consider documenting the false-positive class in the manifest comment, or narrowing the generic branch to the four fixed labels plus an explicit `busyPhase` vocabulary if one exists.

- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1446` → `main`
- **State**: open

- **Updated**: 2026-10-09T20:45:25Z

## PR Description

Closes #1446
### What changed

TUI transient chrome becomes signal-only (gh-1446): the streaming fold row renders as a textless dim rule (`─`×width, count retracted), the background-jobs line collapses to `<status.running glyph> Background jobs (R)` + `· L lost` (done count and `older` noise dropped; `older` kept only as the frozen pre-turn provenance marker), the busy row loses its kaomoji face (plain label at column 0), and the `>_ Fa` brand mark gains a fixed 1-cell animation slot cycling the existing braille activity ring while a run streams.

### Key decisions

- All status glyphs route through the central symbol table (`TuiSymbols`): `status.running` = `◐`, `status.pending` = `○` (unicode defaults); waiting rows, hub/tree/chrome/tool-liveness hardcoded `⏳`/`⟳` all migrated — the ascii preset can never emit a non-ASCII glyph (AC8 grep is clean outside `tui_symbols.dart`).
- Brand animation stays pure: the host resolves `StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame` from the compile-time `activitySpinner` off the live tick frame (`FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph`); the engine never reads frames, and model text can never become a frame. Idle renders the blank cell so the ` Fa` column is constant.
- Jobs line clip priority is `lost > parens > icon` with a tail-keep fallback — at width 40 with `999 lost` the digits survive; live line never contains `running`/`done` substrings; the settled transcript summary card keeps its terminal counts (deliberate non-goal).
- #827's reserved row budget, #365 fixed-cell busy layout, and #539 frozen older-row snapshots all preserved; the busy tick chain remains the single animation clock (ctrl+C hint hides the row with the animation — no orphan ticker).

### How to verify

```bash
flutter test test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart test/cli/tui_symbols_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_busy_row_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_kaomoji_test.dart \
  test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_band_composer_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_viewport_fold_test.dart test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart
flutter test test/cli  # 3416 passed (1 pre-existing env failure, see below)
```

Note: `backend_mode_cli_test`, `headless_log_file_test`, `agent_cli_task_completion_wake_test`, `browser_ext/*` (Chrome/D-Bus unavailable) fail identically on the base commit `e3d0dc5` — pre-existing runner-environment issues, untouched here.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  TICK[SpinnerTickMsg 100ms] --> MODEL[FaTuiModel.spinnerFrame]
  MODEL --> CTL[FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph]
  CTL --> SNAP[StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame]
  SNAP --> PI[_renderPi: >_ + frame + Fa]
  SNAP --> BAND[band writer: fade roles kept]
  BOARD[ShellJobBoard.liveLines] --> LINE[shellJobLiveSummaryLine: glyph + (R) + L lost]
  LINE --> CLIP[_tailKeep clip ladder: lost > parens > icon]
  ROWS[_busyRowLine] --> PLAIN[plain label col 0 - no face]

```

- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1446` → `main`
- **State**: open

- **Updated**: 2026-10-09T20:45:25Z

## PR Description

Closes #1446
### What changed

TUI transient chrome becomes signal-only (gh-1446): the streaming fold row renders as a textless dim rule (`─`×width, count retracted), the background-jobs line collapses to `<status.running glyph> Background jobs (R)` + `· L lost` (done count and `older` noise dropped; `older` kept only as the frozen pre-turn provenance marker), the busy row loses its kaomoji face (plain label at column 0), and the `>_ Fa` brand mark gains a fixed 1-cell animation slot cycling the existing braille activity ring while a run streams.

### Key decisions

- All status glyphs route through the central symbol table (`TuiSymbols`): `status.running` = `◐`, `status.pending` = `○` (unicode defaults); waiting rows, hub/tree/chrome/tool-liveness hardcoded `⏳`/`⟳` all migrated — the ascii preset can never emit a non-ASCII glyph (AC8 grep is clean outside `tui_symbols.dart`).
- Brand animation stays pure: the host resolves `StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame` from the compile-time `activitySpinner` off the live tick frame (`FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph`); the engine never reads frames, and model text can never become a frame. Idle renders the blank cell so the ` Fa` column is constant.
- Jobs line clip priority is `lost > parens > icon` with a tail-keep fallback — at width 40 with `999 lost` the digits survive; live line never contains `running`/`done` substrings; the settled transcript summary card keeps its terminal counts (deliberate non-goal).
- #827's reserved row budget, #365 fixed-cell busy layout, and #539 frozen older-row snapshots all preserved; the busy tick chain remains the single animation clock (ctrl+C hint hides the row with the animation — no orphan ticker).

### How to verify

```bash
flutter test test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart test/cli/tui_symbols_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_busy_row_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_kaomoji_test.dart \
  test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_band_composer_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_viewport_fold_test.dart test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart
flutter test test/cli  # 3416 passed (1 pre-existing env failure, see below)
```

Note: `backend_mode_cli_test`, `headless_log_file_test`, `agent_cli_task_completion_wake_test`, `browser_ext/*` (Chrome/D-Bus unavailable) fail identically on the base commit `e3d0dc5` — pre-existing runner-environment issues, untouched here.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  TICK[SpinnerTickMsg 100ms] --> MODEL[FaTuiModel.spinnerFrame]
  MODEL --> CTL[FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph]

  SNAP --> BAND[band writer: fade roles kept]

## PR Description

Closes #1446
### What changed

TUI transient chrome becomes signal-only (gh-1446): the streaming fold row renders as a textless dim rule (`─`×width, count retracted), the background-jobs line collapses to `<status.running glyph> Background jobs (R)` + `· L lost` (done count and `older` noise dropped; `older` kept only as the frozen pre-turn provenance marker), the busy row loses its kaomoji face (plain label at column 0), and the `>_ Fa` brand mark gains a fixed 1-cell animation slot cycling the existing braille activity ring while a run streams.

### Key decisions

- All status glyphs route through the central symbol table (`TuiSymbols`): `status.running` = `◐`, `status.pending` = `○` (unicode defaults); waiting rows, hub/tree/chrome/tool-liveness hardcoded `⏳`/`⟳` all migrated — the ascii preset can never emit a non-ASCII glyph (AC8 grep is clean outside `tui_symbols.dart`).
- Brand animation stays pure: the host resolves `StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame` from the compile-time `activitySpinner` off the live tick frame (`FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph`); the engine never reads frames, and model text can never become a frame. Idle renders the blank cell so the ` Fa` column is constant.
- Jobs line clip priority is `lost > parens > icon` with a tail-keep fallback — at width 40 with `999 lost` the digits survive; live line never contains `running`/`done` substrings; the settled transcript summary card keeps its terminal counts (deliberate non-goal).
- #827's reserved row budget, #365 fixed-cell busy layout, and #539 frozen older-row snapshots all preserved; the busy tick chain remains the single animation clock (ctrl+C hint hides the row with the animation — no orphan ticker).

### How to verify

```bash
flutter test test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart test/cli/tui_symbols_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_busy_row_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_kaomoji_test.dart \

  test/cli/fa_tui_viewport_fold_test.dart test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart
flutter test test/cli  # 3416 passed (1 pre-existing env failure, see below)
```

Note: `backend_mode_cli_test`, `headless_log_file_test`, `agent_cli_task_completion_wake_test`, `browser_ext/*` (Chrome/D-Bus unavailable) fail identically on the base commit `e3d0dc5` — pre-existing runner-environment issues, untouched here.

## PR Description

Closes #1446
### What changed

TUI transient chrome becomes signal-only (gh-1446): the streaming fold row renders as a textless dim rule (`─`×width, count retracted), the background-jobs line collapses to `<status.running glyph> Background jobs (R)` + `· L lost` (done count and `older` noise dropped; `older` kept only as the frozen pre-turn provenance marker), the busy row loses its kaomoji face (plain label at column 0), and the `>_ Fa` brand mark gains a fixed 1-cell animation slot cycling the existing braille activity ring while a run streams.

### Key decisions

- All status glyphs route through the central symbol table (`TuiSymbols`): `status.running` = `◐`, `status.pending` = `○` (unicode defaults); waiting rows, hub/tree/chrome/tool-liveness hardcoded `⏳`/`⟳` all migrated — the ascii preset can never emit a non-ASCII glyph (AC8 grep is clean outside `tui_symbols.dart`).
- Brand animation stays pure: the host resolves `StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame` from the compile-time `activitySpinner` off the live tick frame (`FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph`); the engine never reads frames, and model text can never become a frame. Idle renders the blank cell so the ` Fa` column is constant.
- Jobs line clip priority is `lost > parens > icon` with a tail-keep fallback — at width 40 with `999 lost` the digits survive; live line never contains `running`/`done` substrings; the settled transcript summary card keeps its terminal counts (deliberate non-goal).
- #827's reserved row budget, #365 fixed-cell busy layout, and #539 frozen older-row snapshots all preserved; the busy tick chain remains the single animation clock (ctrl+C hint hides the row with the animation — no orphan ticker).

### How to verify

```bash
flutter test test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart test/cli/tui_symbols_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_busy_row_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_kaomoji_test.dart \
  test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_band_composer_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_viewport_fold_test.dart test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart
flutter test test/cli  # 3416 passed (1 pre-existing env failure, see below)
```

Note: `backend_mode_cli_test`, `headless_log_file_test`, `agent_cli_task_completion_wake_test`, `browser_ext/*` (Chrome/D-Bus unavailable) fail identically on the base commit `e3d0dc5` — pre-existing runner-environment issues, untouched here.

flowchart TD
  TICK[SpinnerTickMsg 100ms] --> MODEL[FaTuiModel.spinnerFrame]
  MODEL --> CTL[FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph]

- **Title**: gh-1446 [GOAL] TUI chrome diet: textless fold rule, running/lost-only jobs line, live activity animation in the reserved _ Fa brand slot
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1446` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 55
- **Additions**: +1129
- **Deletions**: -566
- **Created**: 2026-10-09T14:51:10Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-09T20:45:25Z

## PR Description

Closes #1446
### What changed

TUI transient chrome becomes signal-only (gh-1446): the streaming fold row renders as a textless dim rule (`─`×width, count retracted), the background-jobs line collapses to `<status.running glyph> Background jobs (R)` + `· L lost` (done count and `older` noise dropped; `older` kept only as the frozen pre-turn provenance marker), the busy row loses its kaomoji face (plain label at column 0), and the `>_ Fa` brand mark gains a fixed 1-cell animation slot cycling the existing braille activity ring while a run streams.

### Key decisions

- All status glyphs route through the central symbol table (`TuiSymbols`): `status.running` = `◐`, `status.pending` = `○` (unicode defaults); waiting rows, hub/tree/chrome/tool-liveness hardcoded `⏳`/`⟳` all migrated — the ascii preset can never emit a non-ASCII glyph (AC8 grep is clean outside `tui_symbols.dart`).
- Brand animation stays pure: the host resolves `StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame` from the compile-time `activitySpinner` off the live tick frame (`FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph`); the engine never reads frames, and model text can never become a frame. Idle renders the blank cell so the ` Fa` column is constant.
- Jobs line clip priority is `lost > parens > icon` with a tail-keep fallback — at width 40 with `999 lost` the digits survive; live line never contains `running`/`done` substrings; the settled transcript summary card keeps its terminal counts (deliberate non-goal).
- #827's reserved row budget, #365 fixed-cell busy layout, and #539 frozen older-row snapshots all preserved; the busy tick chain remains the single animation clock (ctrl+C hint hides the row with the animation — no orphan ticker).

### How to verify

```bash
flutter test test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart test/cli/tui_symbols_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_busy_row_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_kaomoji_test.dart \
  test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_band_composer_test.dart \
  test/cli/fa_tui_viewport_fold_test.dart test/cli/shell_job_board_test.dart
flutter test test/cli  # 3416 passed (1 pre-existing env failure, see below)
```

Note: `backend_mode_cli_test`, `headless_log_file_test`, `agent_cli_task_completion_wake_test`, `browser_ext/*` (Chrome/D-Bus unavailable) fail identically on the base commit `e3d0dc5` — pre-existing runner-environment issues, untouched here.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  TICK[SpinnerTickMsg 100ms] --> MODEL[FaTuiModel.spinnerFrame]
  MODEL --> CTL[FaTuiController.brandFrameGlyph]
  CTL --> SNAP[StatusLineSnapshot.brandFrame]
  SNAP --> PI[_renderPi: >_ + frame + Fa]
  SNAP --> BAND[band writer: fade roles kept]
  BOARD[ShellJobBoard.liveLines] --> LINE[shellJobLiveSummaryLine: glyph + (R) + L lost]
  LINE --> CLIP[_tailKeep clip ladder: lost > parens > icon]
  ROWS[_busyRowLine] --> PLAIN[plain label col 0 - no face]
  SYM[TuiSymbols presets] --> LINE & ROWS & WAIT[waiting rows: status.pending]
```

</details>
